description: Look up US nonprofits and their IRS Form 990 financials via ProPublica's Nonprofit Explorer API.

tools.name: organizations_get
tools.description: Returns the organization profile plus filings_with_data (parsed financials) and filings_without_data (PDF-only). Required: ein.

params.name: ein
params.description: Employer Identification Number, digits only (no dash).

tools.name: search-json_search-organizations
tools.description: Full-text search across organization names. Supports filtering by state, NTEE major group, and 501(c) sub-code. Paginated (100 results per page). Optional: q, state[id], ntee[id] (plus 2 more). Returns array of SearchOrg.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text query matched against organization names.

params.name: state[id]
params.description: Two-letter US state abbreviation (e.g. CA) to filter results.

params.name: ntee[id]
params.description: NTEE major group id 1-10 to filter by cause area.
